# Oleksandr Yukhno

> Operational transformation · PMO and change management · AI in processes. I see a company as a system where processes, technology and finance, together with employees and customers, have to work as one, and that is how I build change. For me, AI is a tool: an exoskeleton within this system. I can help companies that are changing and rebuilding their operations. I am looking for projects and roles in operational and AI transformation, where the PMO becomes the centre of change management and I am responsible for results.

Online CV in English and Ukrainian, in two views: a short CV and a fuller Story. Contact via LinkedIn only.

## Projects

- [Autosound Tuning Skill](https://github.com/ayukhno/autosound-tuning-skill): a deterministic seven-phase process for car-audio DSP tuning, with AI flexible at every step
- [Autosound TCC](https://github.com/ayukhno/autosound-tcc): multilingual desktop app for macOS and Windows on top of the skill
- [This website](https://github.com/ayukhno/ayukhno.github.io): built with Claude, Codex and Gemini; the direction and the check of every line are mine
